title: PUT /v1/tasks/{task}/modes/{mode} request
description: Switch a working mode on for the task (writers of the workgroup, ADR-098 section 3): a person in the browser (way web) or the person's agent outside the platform (way tool). An agent whose pairing belongs to a session is refused (403 mode_needs_instruction) unless it passes on a mode of its own task that has passes_on to a task it created (way inherited). A mode that needs another that is off is 409 mode_needs. No settings in catalogue v1.
